name: French Island National Park
tagline: French Island — Tankerton ferry day; koalas never promised.

practical.ticket_note: Park free; Western Port ferry tickets separate.
practical.transit_note: Passenger ferry from Stony Point to Tankerton; services can cancel.
practical.energy_note: Mosquitoes; limited medical help on the island; pack water.
practical.best_start: Tankerton jetty → short woodland walk → one wetland view
practical.season_note: Year-round ferry weather; winter can be wet and windy.
